profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Anthony and I am a fullstack software engineer, currently working as a backend engineer for Cisco Systems.

Resume down below!

Our team at Cisco thrives on innovation, and my role as a Software Engineer II empowers us to advance cutting-edge software solutions. I’ve led projects and enabled the completion new software features with tight deadlines.

My commitment to excellence is reflected in the significant contributions I’ve made to Cisco's software products. The competencies I honed at Cisco and Hack Reactor, combined with my technical acumen, enable me to deliver high-quality code and diagnose complex issues effectively, ensuring a seamless user experience.

So if you want an experienced problem solving engineer on your team, let's connect! If email is more your speed, feel free to send one to hireanthonycella@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led the development of a testing framework for a new software feature
- In charge of diagnosing, triaging, and occasionally fixing major code issues in a new software product in development to improve code reliability.
- Provided major urgent contributions to the completion of a new software feature, resulting in an extended contract with a major customer earning the company $3 million.
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Unit Testing and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Led backend testing for a new software product feature.
- Implemented production grade code for new application features.
- Investigated production bugs for verification before production release.
- Refactored automated testing frameworks for exponentially better coverage.
- Authored documentation used by onboarding engineers to decrease onboarding time.
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Unit Testing and +4 skills

positions.title: Vroom | A ride share app to cut costs of road travel
positions.description:
➢ Spearheaded team GIT workflow process allowing work to encompass all pull requests minimizing system conflicts. 
➢ Constructed data flow using React Router to allow a smooth and simple user experience.
➢ Implemented the majority of client side functionality using React and Axios to allow users to manage their trips, review other users, and pay drivers their portion of the cost of the trip.

positions.title: Noogle Translate | An application to help engineers learn new coding languages
positions.description:
➢ Integrated user authentication using Auth0 allowing a sign in functionality and future developments in authentication of contributions.
➢ Implemented autocomplete search using an input text field and a prefix tree allowing an elevated user experience when searching for a topic.
➢ Created an automatically typing carousel using React hooks to create a more inviting landing page.

positions.title: Project Atelier | A mock E-Commerce website for clothing and fashion
positions.description:
➢ Architected a UI with React allowing users to choose between styles, add items to their cart, and 
    even share content on social media.
➢ Constructed an image gallery using React allowing users to switch between images of a 
    style, expand the image gallery view, and zoom in/pan on an image.
➢ Integrated variable themes using React Context allowing users to change the color scheme of the 
    site.

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
In 2020 and 2021 I helped lead our store break the company world record for number of holiday gift cards sold two years in a row, meeting goals corporate management deemed impossible, and earning an extra $22,000 and $30,000 for the company in 34 days and 35 days respectively.

In 2021 I broke the company wide world record for number of holiday gift cards sold by an individual in one holiday season. Breaking the previous record of ~250 set the previous year, I sold 403 in 35 days: earning an extra $8,060 for the company, and subsequently receiving a $600 bonus on my paycheck and a promotion offer to Store Manager.

Informally known as the ‘Head Supervisor’ of our flagship store, I led and trained employees and supervisors alike, developed new processes to improve customer experience, helped take care of customers, and set and held high standards while maintaining a positive work environment.

positions.title: Laboratory Assistant
positions.description:
Worked in a team production environment to prepare a specified amount of urine samples for manual retesting in pre-employment drug test and medical drug test scenarios. Employee task list changed daily.

I also personally handled samples from the Department of Transportation and personally handled and prepared various high profile samples for retesting. These high profile clients include the Nuclear Regulatory Commission as well as other private clients.

At age 18 I achieved an employee score of 89/100 for my first six-month assessment. Six months later I achieved a 94/100 on my second and final assessment before my departure.

I also occasionally worked in the Evidence department and helped with sample storage and disposal. In addition, in the midst of a company-wide computer shutdown due to a Ransomware attack, I trained my colleagues to complete evidence department work while the problem was dealt with, saving the company thousands of dollars in labor over the course of several days.
positions.insights: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Problem Solving and +2 skills
